findings.description: The dossier's fallback branch is documented as showing type plus raw payload, but it now prints the decoder's projection (`JSON.stringify({ ...event, type: undefined })`). Any key the decoder doesn't extract (such as the conductor's `target` on `turn_died`, or extra keys on `question`) drops out of the dossier silently. This also makes `decodeEvent`'s `turn_died` key order (session.repository.ts:486-495) a display concern. Either render `row.payload` here, or update the `timelineDatum` comment.

`dashboardSession` passes raw `EventRow[]` to five readers (newestSteer, openQuestion, newestGate, newestDeadTurn, dashboardEvent), and each one calls `decodeEvent` on the same rows again. Decoding once where `events` is built (keeping `created_at` alongside each decoded event) would remove the repeated work and the row/event pairing.
`renderSessionDossierHtml` decodes every event to find the latest merge, then `timelineDatum` decodes each row again. Decode the list once and pass the decoded events to both.

`events.flatMap(... ? [event.report] : [])[0]` builds a whole array just to take its first element. Use `find(...)` then `?.report`, or the same early-return loop that `review.service`'s `lastGateReport` and `dashboard.service`'s `newestGate` use.

Three places still each compute "newest gate_result with a report": dashboard.service `newestGate`, report.service (100-104) and review.service `lastGateReport` (46-52). The overlap predates this PR, which moved all three onto `decodeEvent` but kept them as separate lookups.

process_issues.description: The conventions reviewer reported partial coverage. It read only the session.repository.ts and session-event.types.ts diffs plus a grep over the other non-test sources. It did not read the changed test files against docs/conventions/testing.md, and it did not read docs/09-decisions.md decision 68 directly. The security and correctness reviewers independently confirmed that every renderer still sanitizes (the decision 68 obligation).
The review-context reviewer was not spawned: the diff touches no spec, protocol or infra surface (only src/core and src/cli TypeScript).
